name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides income support directly to the bank accounts of eligible farmer families to help meet agricultural and household needs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to the farmer's bank account (DBT).
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in, through a Common Service Centre (CSC), or at the local revenue/agriculture office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Crop insurance scheme that provides financial support to farmers in case of crop loss or damage due to natural calamities, pests, or diseases.
benefits: Low-premium crop insurance (2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi crops) with claim payouts covering yield losses from natural calamities.
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, Common Service Centres, insurance company portals, or the PMFBY national portal before the crop season cut-off date.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides farmers with timely access to affordable short-term credit for cultivation and other agricultural needs.
benefits: Short-term credit up to ₹3 lakh at subsidized interest rates (as low as 4% with prompt repayment) for crop and allied activities.
how_to_apply: Apply at any nationalized bank, cooperative bank, or regional rural bank branch.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Provides free health insurance cover for secondary and tertiary hospitalization to economically vulnerable families.
benefits: Health cover of up to ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalization at empanelled public and private hospitals.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or through a Common Service Centre; get an Ayushman card issued at empanelled hospitals or CSCs.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Promotes institutional delivery to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality among poor pregnant women.
benefits: Cash assistance for institutional delivery: ₹1,400 (rural) / ₹1,000 (urban) in low-performing states, with additional accredited social health activist (ASHA) incentives.
how_to_apply: Register at the nearest government hospital or health sub-centre during pregnancy through ASHA workers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Provides cash incentives to pregnant and lactating mothers for their first live birth to compensate for wage loss and improve health-seeking behavior.
benefits: ₹5,000 in three installments for the first living child, linked to health check-ups and registration milestones.
how_to_apply: Register online at the PMMVY portal or through the local Anganwadi centre / ASHA worker.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides financial assistance to rural households for construction of a pucca house with basic amenities.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.2 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.3 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for house construction, plus convergence with MGNREGA for labor.
how_to_apply: Beneficiaries are identified from the Awaas+ survey list; apply/verify status at the Gram Panchayat office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides affordable housing and interest subsidies on home loans to economically weaker sections and low/middle-income urban households.
benefits: Interest subsidy of up to 6.5% on home loans and direct financial assistance for house construction/purchase, depending on income category.
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmay-urban.gov.in or through the Urban Local Body / bank offering the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Financial assistance to SC, ST, and OBC students studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to help them complete their education.
benefits: Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, and other education-related expenses for eligible students.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with institution verification.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Provides scholarships to meritorious students from economically weaker sections to help reduce dropout rates at the secondary school stage.
benefits: ₹12,000 per year (₹1,000 per month) from class 9 to 12 for selected meritorious students.
how_to_apply: Selection is via a state-level examination; apply through school and the National Scholarship Portal.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: A national campaign to address the declining child sex ratio and promote the education and empowerment of the girl child.
benefits: Community awareness programs, incentives for girl-child education, and convergence with schemes like Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana in focus districts.
documents_required: Birth certificate of the girl child
how_to_apply: Implemented through district-level committees and Anganwadi centres; no separate individual application in most components.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: A small savings scheme for the girl child that encourages parents to build a fund for her education and marriage expenses.
benefits: High interest-rate (government-notified, currently around 8%) savings account with tax benefits under Section 80C, maturing when the girl turns 21.
how_to_apply: Open an account at any post office or authorized bank branch in the name of the girl child.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees at least 100 days of wage employment per financial year to rural households whose adult members volunteer for unskilled manual work.
benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per year at the notified minimum wage for unskilled manual work near the applicant's residence.
how_to_apply: Apply for a job card at the Gram Panchayat office; work is allotted within 15 days of demand.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Provides free short-term skill training and certification to youth to improve employability and livelihood opportunities.
benefits: Free industry-relevant skill training, certification, and placement assistance; some courses include a monetary reward on certification.
how_to_apply: Register at a nearby PMKVY training centre or through the Skill India portal (skillindia.gov.in).

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Provides placement-linked skill training to rural poor youth to help them access sustainable employment.
benefits: Free residential/non-residential skill training aligned to market demand, along with placement support and post-placement tracking.
how_to_apply: Apply through project implementing agencies or the DDU-GKY portal (ddugky.gov.in).

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading, targeted at women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
benefits: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for setting up a new enterprise, with handholding support for loan processing.
how_to_apply: Apply online at standupmitra.in or approach the nearest bank branch.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides collateral-free loans to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises for income-generating activities.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 lakh (Shishu up to ₹50,000, Kishor up to ₹5 lakh, Tarun up to ₹10 lakh, Tarun Plus up to ₹20 lakh) for micro and small businesses.
how_to_apply: Apply at any public/private sector bank, regional rural bank, or microfinance institution.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: A credit-linked subsidy scheme to generate self-employment opportunities by helping set up new micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector.
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 15-35% of project cost (higher for special categories/rural areas), with the balance financed as a bank loan.
documents_required: Educational certificate (8th pass minimum for larger projects)
how_to_apply: Apply online at the PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal).

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Provides affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of up to ₹10,000 (first tranche), rising to ₹20,000 and ₹50,000 on timely repayment, with interest subsidy.
documents_required: Certificate of Vending / Letter of Recommendation
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through the Urban Local Body / lending institution.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople (like carpenters, potters, cobblers, weavers) with skill training, tools, and credit access.
benefits: Skill training with stipend, a toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh in two tranches at concessional interest.
how_to_apply: Register through the Common Service Centre or the PM Vishwakarma portal (pmvishwakarma.gov.in).

name: e-Shram Portal Registration
description: Creates a national database of unorganized workers to enable them to access social security schemes and welfare benefits.
benefits: Issuance of a Universal Account Number (UAN) card, access to social security schemes, and ₹2 lakh accidental insurance cover.
how_to_apply: Register free of cost online at eshram.gov.in or through a Common Service Centre.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: A guaranteed pension scheme aimed at workers in the unorganized sector to provide them income security after retirement.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 from age 60, depending on contribution amount and age at joining.
how_to_apply: Apply through the bank or post office where you hold a savings account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maandhan (PM-SYM)
description: A voluntary pension scheme for unorganized sector workers to provide old-age income security.
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60, with matching government contribution equal to the subscriber's contribution.
how_to_apply: Register at the nearest Common Service Centre with Aadhaar and bank account details.

name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)
description: A pension scheme for senior citizens that provides an assured return on investment through a lump-sum purchase price.
benefits: Assured pension payouts (monthly/quarterly/annual) at a government-notified rate on a lump-sum investment, for 10 years.
how_to_apply: Purchase the policy through LIC branches or the LIC online portal.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Provides monthly pension to elderly citizens living below the poverty line as part of the National Social Assistance Programme.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200-500 (60-79 years) or ₹500+ (80+ years), amounts vary by state top-up contributions.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat, block office, or district social welfare office.

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
description: Provides a lump-sum grant to a BPL household on the death of the primary breadwinner, to help the family cope with the sudden loss of income.
benefits: One-time lump-sum assistance of ₹20,000 to the bereaved BPL household.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat or local revenue/social welfare office within the notified time period.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Promotes financial inclusion by providing access to basic banking, credit, insurance, and pension services for all households.
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, RuPay debit card with ₹2 lakh accident insurance cover, and access to overdraft facility.
how_to_apply: Open an account at any bank branch or Bank Mitra (business correspondent) outlet.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: An affordable life insurance scheme that provides life cover in case of death of the insured due to any reason.
benefits: Life insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for an annual premium of ₹436, renewable yearly, auto-debited from a linked bank account.
how_to_apply: Enroll through the bank or post office where you hold a savings account.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: An affordable accident insurance scheme covering death or disability due to accident.
benefits: Accidental death/full disability cover of ₹2 lakh and partial disability cover of ₹1 lakh, for an annual premium of ₹20.
how_to_apply: Enroll through the bank or post office where you hold a savings account.

name: National Pension System (NPS)
description: A voluntary, defined-contribution retirement savings scheme open to all citizens to build a pension corpus.
benefits: Market-linked retirement savings with tax benefits under Section 80CCD, and a mix of lump-sum withdrawal and annuity pension at retirement.
how_to_apply: Open an NPS account online via eNPS (enps.nsdl.com) or through a bank/point of presence.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides free LPG gas connections to women from below-poverty-line households to replace unsafe cooking fuels.
benefits: Free LPG gas connection with financial support for the deposit and first refill; subsidized cylinder refills thereafter.
how_to_apply: Apply at the nearest LPG distributor with required documents, or online at pmuy.gov.in.

name: Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana (Saubhagya)
description: Aims to achieve universal household electrification by providing free electricity connections to poor households.
benefits: Free electricity connection for BPL households (nominal cost in installments for others) including wiring and a meter.
how_to_apply: Apply at the local electricity distribution company office or through camps organized under the scheme.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Aims to provide safe and adequate piped drinking water connections to every rural household.
benefits: Functional household tap connection providing regular piped drinking water at the community/household level.
how_to_apply: Village Water and Sanitation Committees coordinate connections; contact the Gram Panchayat for status/registration.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) - Individual Household Latrine
description: Provides financial incentives to rural households for constructing individual household toilets to end open defecation.
benefits: Financial incentive of ₹12,000 for construction of an individual household latrine for eligible rural households.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Gram Panchayat under the Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) program.

name: Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Provides highly subsidized foodgrains to the poorest of poor families identified under the Public Distribution System.
benefits: 35 kg of foodgrains per household per month at highly subsidized rates (₹2/kg wheat, ₹3/kg rice).
how_to_apply: Apply for an AAY ration card at the local Public Distribution System / civil supplies office.

name: National Food Security Act (NFSA) - Public Distribution System
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Provides subsidized foodgrains to about two-thirds of the population through fair price shops under a legal entitlement.
benefits: 5 kg of foodgrains per person per month at subsidized prices (₹1-3/kg) through fair price shops.
how_to_apply: Apply for a ration card at the district food and civil supplies office or online state portal.

name: One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Allows migrant ration cardholders to access their food grain entitlement from any fair price shop across the country.
benefits: Portability of ration card benefits nationwide via biometric/Aadhaar authentication at any ePOS-enabled fair price shop.
how_to_apply: No separate application needed if the ration card is already Aadhaar-seeded; link Aadhaar at the local ration office if not done.

name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides aids and assistive devices to persons with disabilities to improve their physical, social, and economic rehabilitation.
benefits: Free or subsidized assistive devices such as wheelchairs, hearing aids, artificial limbs, and tricycles, depending on income slab.
how_to_apply: Apply through empanelled implementing agencies, camps, or district disability rehabilitation centres.

name: Scholarship for Students with Disabilities (Divyangjan)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides pre-matric and post-matric scholarships to students with disabilities to support their education.
benefits: Covers tuition fees, maintenance allowance, book grants, and reader/escort allowance for students with disabilities.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (RVY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides senior citizens belonging to BPL households with physical aids and assisted-living devices for age-related disabilities.
benefits: Free distribution of aids and assisted-living devices such as walking sticks, wheelchairs, hearing aids, and spectacles.
how_to_apply: Apply through district-level camps organized by ALIMCO or the district social welfare office.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
description: Provides financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, and market entry.
benefits: Grants up to ₹20 lakh for proof of concept and investment up to ₹50 lakh for market entry/scaling, disbursed through incubators.
how_to_apply: Apply online through an approved incubator listed on the Startup India Seed Fund portal.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Enables micro and small enterprises to obtain collateral-free credit from banks and financial institutions.
benefits: Collateral-free credit guarantee cover up to ₹5 crore for eligible micro and small enterprise loans.
documents_required: Loan application with the lending bank
how_to_apply: Apply through a member lending institution (bank/NBFC) registered under CGTMSE.

name: PM-DAKSH Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides skill development training to marginalized groups including SC, OBC, EWS, and safai karamcharis to enhance their employability.
benefits: Free skill training with stipend, covering up-skilling, entrepreneurship development, and short-term/long-term courses.
how_to_apply: Register online at pmdaksh.dosje.gov.in for available training batches.

name: Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Aims to make rural households digitally literate by training at least one member per family in basic digital skills.
benefits: Free training in basic digital literacy (using devices, internet, digital payments, government e-services) with a certificate on passing.
how_to_apply: Register at the nearest Common Service Centre or through the PMGDISHA portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Van Dhan Yojana (PMVDY)
description: Promotes value addition to minor forest produce collected by tribal gatherers through skill upgradation and infrastructure support.
benefits: Formation of Van Dhan Vikas Kendras providing skill training, working capital, and market linkage for value-added forest produce.
how_to_apply: Join through a local Van Dhan Vikas Kendra facilitated by TRIFED and state tribal welfare departments.

name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Creates a digital health ecosystem giving every citizen a unique health ID to access and share health records securely.
benefits: Free ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) ID enabling digital storage and sharing of health records across participating facilities.
how_to_apply: Create an ABHA ID online at abdm.gov.in, via the ABHA mobile app, or at any participating hospital.

name: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Provides comprehensive healthcare to central government employees, pensioners, and their dependents in covered cities.
benefits: Cashless outpatient and inpatient treatment at CGHS wellness centres and empanelled hospitals for beneficiaries and dependents.
how_to_apply: Apply for a CGHS card through the employing department or pension disbursing authority.

name: Mahila Udyam Nidhi / Stree Shakti Package for Women Entrepreneurs
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Provides financial support and concessional lending terms to women entrepreneurs setting up small-scale industries.
benefits: Concessional loans and interest rate rebates for women-owned micro and small enterprises via participating banks/SIDBI.
how_to_apply: Apply through SIDBI or participating public sector banks.

name: Eklavya Model Residential School Scheme (EMRS)
description: Establishes residential schools for tribal students to provide quality education comparable to top central schools.
benefits: Free residential quality education from class 6 to 12, including boarding, lodging, and study materials.
how_to_apply: Admission through entrance test conducted by the EMRS Society; apply through the school or district tribal welfare office.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
description: Provides financial assistance to students from notified minority communities studying in classes 1 to 10 to reduce dropout rates.
benefits: Annual scholarship covering admission fees, tuition fees, and maintenance allowance for eligible minority students.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: State Widow Pension Scheme (Central Convergence under NSAP)
description: Provides monthly financial assistance to widows from below-poverty-line households as part of the National Social Assistance Programme.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹300 (base central assistance, often topped up by states) to eligible widows.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat or block-level social welfare office.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Provides monthly pension to persons with severe or multiple disabilities from below-poverty-line households.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹300 (base central assistance, higher with state top-up) for persons with 80% or more disability.
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat or block-level social welfare office.

name: Annapurna Scheme
description: Provides free foodgrains to elderly citizens who are eligible for old-age pension but are not currently receiving it.
benefits: 10 kg of free foodgrains per month to eligible senior citizens not covered under the old-age pension scheme.
documents_required: Certificate of non-coverage under old-age pension
how_to_apply: Apply at the Gram Panchayat or municipal social welfare office.
